events.speaker: ELEANOR
events.text: Hold the herd. I'll ask what's troubling our neighbor.

events.speaker: ELEANOR
events.text: Easy. Nobody's driving you anywhere tonight.

events.speaker: ELEANOR
events.text: There you are. You only wanted someone to listen.

events.speaker: TRAIL BOSS
events.text: You've got their attention. I'll keep the strays off your heels.

events.speaker: ELEANOR
events.text: One brave soul. Mostly interested in the grass, I think.

events.speaker: ELEANOR
events.text: Everyone across. Including one who hasn't needed a bridge in years.

events.speaker: ELEANOR
events.text: You stayed. I knew you would, but I like seeing it.

events.speaker: ELEANOR
events.text: Let's catch our breath. The ford can wait a moment.
